Cummings, Montréal QC H3W 3E8 514-342-1234 514-739-6899 The email address of this
organization is unknown, please contact by phone. This organization belongs to you? Claim
management of this file! Mission Improve the quality of life of retirees by promoting mutual
assistance, social inclusion and access to adapted services. Our objective is to support and
promote the contribution of seniors to community of Montreal, by offering enriching activities and
defending their rights. Join us to be a strong voice for retirees and to create an environment
welcoming and supportive for all seniors. Description The Alliance of Associations of Retirees and
d’Ainés du Québec, based in Montreal, is a community organization committed to the well-being
retirees and seniors in the region. Our mission is to accompany and support this valuable
community through various activities and services adapted to their needs. Specialized in the areas
of retirement and retiree associations, our organization sets up initiatives aimed at improving the
quality of life of seniors, fostering social ties and promoting physical and mental well-being. Our
interventions revolve around the implementation of meetings, workshops and conferences on
various themes such as health, prevention, culture and leisure. We also encourage social and civic
engagement retirees through solidarity actions and community projects. Organization of cultural
and recreational events Prevention and awareness workshops Solidarity and volunteers In the
heart of the city of Montreal, the Alliance of Associations of Retirees and Seniors of Quebec is a key
player in local community life, working for the well-being and the development of seniors. Join us in
this great collective adventure dedicated to better life for retirees and seniors in our beautiful region!
